answer_1.quote: We propose three sequence-to-sequence pretraining objectives ... for abstractive document summarization ... The task of abstractive document summarization is modeled as a SEQ2SEQ learning problem.

answer_2.quote: We used ROUGE to measure the quality of different summarization model outputs.

answer_4.quote: We also evaluated abstractive systems by eliciting human judgements. 10 participants are presented with a document and a list of outputs ... they are asked to rank the outputs of these systems from best to worst according to informativeness, fluency, and succinctness.
answer_4.guideline: Participants ranked system outputs based on informativeness (captures important content), fluency (grammaticality), and succinctness (concise expression).
